title: Aue Station

services.name: A Night in Leon Springs
services.desc: Aue Station comes alive year-round with music and celebrations. Be the first to know about upcoming events-join our newsletter. Join us for a special evening in support of the Day Zero Foundation, helping veterans rebuild, reconnect, and move forward with purpose. Enjoy appetizers, a plated Rudy’s BBQ dinner, desserts, live music featuring the Britt Ballenger Band, a silent auction, a $200 Rudy’s Gift Card raffle, and a beer & wine cash bar. services.name: Private Events
services.desc: From weddings to corporate retreats, host unforgettable events in a one-of-a-kind historic setting. Aue Station offers versatile spaces for any event, including our Holiday Room for indoor seating with AV capabilities, a covered porch area for extended seating and gathering, and a newly renovated flagstone patio. Full-service catering from light bites, Texas bar-b-q, to formal meals, plus coffee service, bar packages, and custom menus. We can tailor your catering needs and accommodate for dietary restrictions.
